title: Square Nim from both ends
plain: Two piles; a move removes a square from one pile or the same square from both. Find the losing positions' asymptotic density.
math: For moves $(a,b)\to(a-k^2,b),(a,b-k^2),(a-k^2,b-k^2)$, prove $\#\{(a,b)\in[N]^2:\mathcal P\}=N^{1+\theta+o(1)}$ and find $\theta$.
